_comment: Targeted 5-prompt subset for the 2026-07-21 prompt-grounding fix.
The first three are the effects whose failures were caused by the prompt
teaching functions that do not exist (ef.ping_pong, ef.chorus, ef.flanger).
ping-pong and flanger failed identically in the 2026-05 and 2026-07-19 runs
and were recorded as persistent MODEL failures; they were prompt bugs.
The last two are controls that already passed, to catch a regression from
time-based: a ping-pong delay that bounces between left and right
a subtle chorus effect with rate and depth
filters: a warm analog-style low-pass filter with cutoff and resonance
trivial: a stereo gain control in decibels
